CHANNEL PARTNER REFERRAL AGREEMENT

This Referral Agreement (this "Agreement") is made as of April 14, 2026 between Halbrook Diagnostics, Inc., a Delaware corporation (the "Company"), and Larkspur Advisory Group LLC, an Ohio limited liability company (the "Referral Partner").

1. REFERRALS. The Referral Partner may introduce prospective customers to the Company by submitting the prospect's name, contact, and a short description through the Company's partner portal. A submission is a "Referral". The Company will accept or decline each Referral within five (5) business days and will not accept a Referral for a prospect already in the Company's pipeline, which the Company will evidence by a dated record.

2. NO AUTHORITY. The Referral Partner is an independent contractor. It has no authority to negotiate, quote, price, contract, or make any representation or warranty on the Company's behalf, and will not hold itself out as able to. Nothing in this Agreement creates a partnership, joint venture, agency, or employment relationship.

3. FEE. For each accepted Referral that becomes a paying customer within one hundred eighty (180) days of acceptance, the Company will pay the Referral Partner ten percent (10%) of the net subscription revenue the Company actually collects from that customer during the first twelve (12) months, capped at $50,000 per customer. Fees are paid within forty-five (45) days after the end of the quarter in which the revenue is collected, with a statement showing the calculation.

4. NO FEE FOR REGULATED REFERRALS. No fee is payable for a Referral of any customer that is a health-care provider, a laboratory, or any other person in a position to refer or order items or services reimbursable by a federal health-care program. The parties intend that this Agreement comply with the federal Anti-Kickback Statute, 42 U.S.C. § 1320a-7b(b), and the Physician Self-Referral Law, 42 U.S.C. § 1395nn, and no fee under this Agreement is intended to induce or reward any such referral.

5. CHARGEBACK. If a customer cancels within ninety (90) days of the first payment or the Company refunds the revenue, the corresponding fee is charged back against future fees or, if none, repaid within thirty (30) days.

6. COMPLIANCE. The Referral Partner will comply with all applicable law, including the FTC Endorsement Guides, the Telephone Consumer Protection Act, and the CAN-SPAM Act, will disclose its material connection to the Company whenever it recommends the Company publicly, and will not make any claim about the Company's products the Company has not approved in writing.

7. NO EXCLUSIVITY. This Agreement is non-exclusive. Each party may enter into similar arrangements with others.

8. CONFIDENTIALITY. Each party will protect the other's confidential information with at least reasonable care and use it only to perform this Agreement, for three years after disclosure.

9. TERM AND TERMINATION. The term is one year and renews for successive one-year terms unless either party gives thirty (30) days' written notice before a renewal date. Either party may terminate for convenience on thirty (30) days' notice, and for material breach not cured within fifteen (15) days of written notice.

10. EFFECT OF TERMINATION. On termination, the Company will pay fees earned on Referrals accepted before termination that convert within the 180-day window, and Sections 2, 4, 8, 10, and 12 survive.

11. LIMITATION OF LIABILITY. Neither party is liable for indirect or consequential damages. Each party's aggregate liability is limited to the fees paid or payable in the twelve months before the claim, except for a breach of Section 4, Section 6, or Section 8.

12. GOVERNING LAW. Ohio law governs. Venue lies in the state and federal courts in Franklin County, Ohio.

HALBROOK DIAGNOSTICS, INC.                LARKSPUR ADVISORY GROUP LLC
